about: What sessions need from the owner, newest first. A session appends an entry here and rebuilds the dashboard (README.md). The owner ticks it on the dashboard; the tick lives in the artifact database as items/req-<id>. Never put an id, key or password in this file: say where it goes.

requests.title: Sign privacy policy version 2 before the next website deploy
requests.detail: The live policy says femio adds no lock of its own (false) and lists only part of what Google's ads SDK sends. The corrected text is in the repository in four languages (docs/compliance/PRIVACY_COHERENCE_2026-11.md section 4). Say 'sign privacy v2' or name the line to change.

requests.title: Play countries: Egypt and Saudi Arabia only, for the test and the first release
requests.detail: Google requires a certified consent message for ads in the EEA, UK and Switzerland, set up in your AdMob account. Until then, list only Egypt and Saudi Arabia (one setting covers every track).

requests.title: Check whether the 12-tester rule applies to femio
requests.detail: Google ties it to personal accounts created after 13 Nov 2023 and names no exemption for an account that already has a published app. Open femio's Dashboard in Play Console: if it offers Production without a closed test, skip it; otherwise 16 testers in Egypt and Saudi Arabia, 12 opted in for 14 days.

requests.title: Three legal questions from the privacy review
requests.detail: An explicit ads consent step in Egypt and Saudi Arabia (Google shows none there), whether Egypt's data-protection licence applies to femio, and the Data safety deletion answer. Recommendation: nothing extra for the test; ask a lawyer about the licence before the paid launch.

requests.title: Which flag for Arabic in the language switcher?
requests.detail: Your flags are live beside the language names. Arabic shows the Saudi flag today, which sits oddly with your note that femio is not Saudi-centric. Say 'keep', or 'a neutral Arabic badge' (a plain ع mark in the brand colours), or name another flag; a session changes one file.
requests.where: Dashboard item phone-check (checked and archived); the flag map is in apps/web/src (search for /flags/)

requests.title: Install release candidate 0.5.2 (the launch crash is fixed) and run the six checks
requests.detail: 0.5.0+5 crashed on opening: the release shrinker removed a class Google's ads SDK needs. 0.5.2 fixes it, guards start-up (a damaged file or key now shows a recovery screen, never a crash), and adds the design fixes, accessibility work and the in-app privacy policy link. It opened cleanly on an Android 16 emulator. Install E:/Femio/apps/mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk over the old one (same key), then the app-checks step; tell a session what is wrong, one line each.
requests.where: Dashboard phase 6, items install-apk and app-checks; file paths in build-rc

requests.title: NVDA: you ticked it, but the notes file does not exist
requests.detail: testing-results/2026-10-28-calendar-a11y/nvda-notes.md is missing. Write the three things you heard (does it read the full date on each day, the result sentence after Enter, nothing twice?) in the nvda step's note, or say 'skip NVDA'. A session records it either way.

requests.title: Import the fixed Tag Manager container file (download it again)
requests.detail: Your 2026-10-28 copy fails Tag Manager's validator; the file in the repository was fixed on 2026-10-30 and a gate check keeps its shape. Download docs/34_GROWTH_OPS/gtm/femio-container.json again, import it (Merge, Rename conflicting), then set your G- id in the constant variable. If it fails again, paste the exact message in chat.

requests.title: Give the legal form and registration number of KM Digital Labs
requests.detail: The privacy policy and terms now print 'KM Digital Labs, Cairo, Egypt' and info@femioapp.com. One line in chat with the legal form (for example sole proprietorship) and the commercial-register or tax number, and the session adds it. Also confirm the mailbox info@femioapp.com exists.
requests.where: Dashboard item legal-placeholders (you ticked it; this is the last piece)

requests.title: Delete NEXT_PUBLIC_BETA_INVITE_CODE and NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GOOGLE_AUTH in Vercel
requests.detail: From your note on vercel-env-clean: those two are left from the v2 sign-in era and nothing reads them. Keep NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_CRISIS_DIRECTORY_URL (both in use). The connector cannot delete variables.

requests.title: Create the AdMob account and put the three ids into ads.env
requests.detail: The app's ads are built and show Google's test ads until apps/mobile/ads.env holds your App ID and two banner unit ids (phase 4: admob-account, admob-units, ads-env). Also the pub- id into Vercel for app-ads.txt. Ids never go into chat.
requests.where: Dashboard phase 4, items admob-account, admob-units, ads-env, app-ads-txt

requests.title: Use the new Play answers: Ads = Yes, and the four Data safety rows
requests.detail: docs/store/data-safety-and-declarations.md was rewritten for ADR-076. The forms and data-safety items in phase 5 carry the exact rows. Nothing to send back unless the Console's wording differs.
requests.where: Dashboard phase 5, items forms and data-safety

requests.title: Run the Play Billing check once on a real phone
requests.detail: The signed build carries the billing library without the INTERNET permission (proved in the build). Only a phone can show whether the library complains. Item billing-probe in phase 6 has the exact steps; send the session the one line the app shows and any SecurityException from adb logcat.

requests.title: Give a session the URL of the one-question feedback form
requests.detail: Routine R4 links to it from the weekly posts and the app's store listing reply template. The form must warn 'do not include health details'. Any form tool works; only the URL is needed.
requests.where: Item feedback-form in phase 2; then tell a session the URL

requests.title: Answer the four content questions
requests.detail: Three Arabic editing decisions in docs/content/reviews/2026-10-28-arabic-editor-pass.md and one clinical one: a source for bleeding and reduced movements on the pregnancy red-flag list, or leave them off. Item content-decisions in phase 2.
requests.where: Dashboard item content-decisions; answers in chat

requests.title: Create the Canva account so a session can build the six templates
requests.detail: The Canva connector is attached to this project but needs your account signed in. Item canva in phase 7.
